title: feat(scenarios): a card names the agent action an operation goes through (via)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9JpRoUZGqtwqMU5k7b4C58D)_
Part of #36206 (item 3 and the PAY-0044 position land here; the column-total half of item 2 waits on the eval seat's re-score and stays open on the card).

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 7077801044 (item 3 C, PAY-0044 folded)

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:评测席位跑场景卡时,经理通过卡片自带的审批动作做决定的那一步,搭建分不再因经理没有直接改审批记录的权限而被扣,改记为“未测”;其余用户无感。
- 为什么做:场景库专题(画廊刷新)里请假余额和采购到收货两张卡,搭建正确却被扣分;顺带修正订单到回款卡上一笔付款落在“近 30 天”边界日、导致卡片答案与平台口径不一致的问题。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是某张卡的这一项授权检查被记为“未测”而不是“失败”,只影响评测分数,改动可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

Against `origin/main` 59392ed1d.

| Part | Change |
|:--|:--|
| Card schema | An operation may carry `via`: the card's own agent action the write is designed to go through. Optional; a card without it reads exactly as before. |
| Loader | Refuses a `via` that is not one of the card's `run.agentActions` on the operation's object (the ruled check), and a `via` on a `refused` operation (a refused write has no route; without this the key would be accepted and do nothing). |
| Grant grading (`gradePersonaGrants`) | `persona-grant:PERSONA:OBJECT:VERB` is **not measured, never a pass**, when the set withholds the verb AND every operation that needs it has a designed route the build declares: its `via` action, or (unchanged) the card's confirm-gated action for a `pending_confirmation` write. A set that grants the verb still passes. An operation without `via` is graded as today, so one unrouted applied write of the same verb keeps the check measured. The existing confirm-gated branch and its detail text are unchanged; the `no designed route` pin (`start_qa`, non-confirm action, no `via`) stays green. |
| Cards | `via: decide_approval_step` on leave_balances `manager_approves_step_one`, requisition_to_receipt `manager_approves_level_one` and travel_expense `manager_approves_step_one`. Not tagged (no measured run yet): asset_lifecycle `manager_approves_scrap`, order_to_cash `approve_discount`. A library pin lists exactly the three tagged operations. |
| PAY-0044 | order_to_cash's PAY-0044 moves from 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-02 (bank reference `ACH-1002-058`), the same one-day move PR #36320 gave TK-0091, and the seed rule names the exception. The library pin of last-N-days truths that change under the platform's preset flips to `[]`. `collected_by_team_last_30_days` west becomes 58300 (was 53500; the payment now falls inside the card's 30-day window too). The only other reader of `payment_date` is the collection-call automation check (paid by due + 15 days), which reads the same for INV-1058 either way. |

`Clause-②: yes (widening)` reading: `src/index.ts` does `export * from './schema.js'`, so `OperationSchema` and `ScenarioCardSchema` are on the package's `.` entry (`package.json` `exports["."]` maps to `dist/index.*`); `PersonaGrantNeed` (gains `routedVia`) is on `./score` via `export * from './scenario-tags.js'`.

**Read first (by risk):**
1. `packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-tags.ts`: `designedRoutes` and the new branch at the top of `gradePersonaGrants`'s needed path; the old confirm branch must read unchanged when no operation names `via`.
2. `packages/qa/scenarios/src/loader.ts`: the `via` block in the operations loop.
3. `docs/qa/scenarios/order_to_cash.json`: PAY-0044 row and the seed-rule sentence.

**Two-minute check:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/score/scenario-tags.test.ts test/refusals.test.ts test/library.test.ts`, expect all green, including the new `an applied write the card routes through its own action` case.

## Tests

- New `scenario-tags.test.ts` case: with the read-only contractor and `start_qa` routed `via set_task_status`, the update check is not measured with the named detail and counts in neither figure; a granting set still passes; a build without the action keeps it measured (fails); the card without `via` fails as before; a second unrouted update keeps it measured.
- Three new `refusals.test.ts` rows: an undeclared action, the card's action on another object, a `via` on a refused write.
- `library.test.ts`: the tagged-operations pin; the last-N-days pin flipped to `[]`.
- `order-to-cash.test.ts`: the `collected_by_team_last_30_days` truth updated to west 58300.

## Acceptance notes

- The loader's refusal of `via` on a `refused` operation goes one step past the ruled text (which names only the not-an-action refusal). Reason: grading reads `via` only on writes that need a grant, so on a refused write the key would be accepted and ignored. It is a refusal on a key that is new in this PR; no card writes it.
- Not tagged, by the ruling: asset_lifecycle `manager_approves_scrap` (`decide_scrap_request`) and order_to_cash `approve_discount` (`decide_discount_approval`) have the same decide-through-action shape, but no measured run shows the grant check failing there yet.
- Item 2b (a decline stating a whole-column total) is not in this PR; it waits on the eval seat's re-score of `september_commission`.

## Verification

Item 3 is graded on the next gallery refresh: leave_balances and requisition_to_receipt Build and Iterate should read `persona-grant:dept_manager:approval_step:update` as not measured when the build routes the decision through `decide_approval_step` without granting the update, and as passed when it grants it.
